rationale: Independent PC001 diagnosis found CURRENT_STUDENT UNRESOLVED: the original and v5 committees were never evaluated on a common DFT set (original has error_c on the 1155-frame test_set; v5 has DFT numbers only on 6 held-out cells). Resolve the primary bottleneck MODEL_SELECTION by evaluating BOTH committees on ONE common DFT set spanning the deployment domain (the 28 al_iter3 SCAN cells, which postdate both students and are thus held-out from both by timing), with identical force-RMSE metric and domain masks, producing a fair per-domain original-vs-v5 fidelity ranking. This is the smallest unbiased model-comparison action and quarantines the historical 'v5 ADOPTED' claim.

integrity.note: original/deployed committee (4 seeds); external CPU path per DISTILLATION_RECIPE.md
teacher reference identity (error_a per-family scale); NOT invoked in this action

parameters.compute_kind: student_committee_inference (SIMPLE-NN via LAMMPS pair_style nn), CPU
parameters.common_dft_set: 28 al_iter3 SCAN cells (v6_dft_batch + heldout_dft_batch + dft_validation_11A); postdate BOTH students
parameters.metric: per-atom force RMSE (eV/A), identical mask for both students; energy reported separately, not mixed with forces
parameters.reference_scale: teacher error_a per-family Fmae (for teacher-vs-distillation localization)
parameters.leakage_note: the 28 al_iter3 cells postdate both students => held-out from both by timing; the RELATIVE ranking is valid without the KISTI v5 train_list (leakage is IMPORTANT_BUT_NONBLOCKING for a relative comparison).

estimated_cost: low (2 committees x 4 seeds x 28 cells of ~40-130 atoms via LAMMPS pair_style nn; CPU; <1 GB; no scheduler, no network)
rollback_or_cleanup_policy: student inference only (no teacher/DFT/MD/training); writes only under runs/production_campaign_001/<run_id>/; refuses a pre-existing run dir; models + DFT cells read-only; on any guard failure remove the run dir; no downstream chain
